claim: In a What's New post dated Jul 15, 2026, Amazon MQ says you can configure the EBS disk storage size of RabbitMQ brokers independently of instance type. It is available for RabbitMQ M7g brokers on version 4.2 or later using cluster deployments only, in increments of 5 GB.
question: When was configurable storage for RabbitMQ announced (What's New date), and which brokers support it?

qualifiers.scope: configurable EBS disk storage size of Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ M7g brokers on version 4.2 or later in cluster deployments

evidence.quote: Configurable storage is available for RabbitMQ M7g brokers on version 4.2 or later using cluster deployments only.
With configurable storage, you can choose a storage size from the default value on M7g to the maximum allowed value depending on your instance size in increments of 5 GB.

evidence.heading: Amazon MQ now supports configurable storage for RabbitMQ brokers

note: d028. Boundary: What's New says Jul 15, 2026; release notes row says July 14, 2026 (fact mq-change-2026-07-configurable-storage-release-notes). Adjudicator applies the 'GA after 2026-07-15 is not examinable yet' rule; neither date is after July 15. Current-truth fact: mq-rabbitmq-configurable-storage-5gb-multiple (page says 4.x).
